sources.note: Scanned primary report; PDF page 74, printed page 78.
PDF has all 400 seats; corresponding XLS exposed only regional seats during retrieval.

limitations: Browser simulations use national entitlements; candidate-list exhaustion, regional overhang, and independent-winning counterfactuals are not implemented.
Regional and compensatory baselines are independently reproduced for 2004-2024; 1994/1999 regional fixtures remain outstanding.
2024 simulations change only the national ballot and hold regional votes fixed.
Socioeconomic data and boundary crosswalks are not yet ingested; no correlations or causal claims are published.
